title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: mobile deposit limits and new-account check holds by tier
content:
## Scope

This quick reference lists, for each tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts, the mobile deposit ceilings and the new-account check hold terms.

## Definitions

- **Mobile deposit daily limit**: the most check value deposited through mobile deposit per calendar day, in USD.
- **Mobile deposit 30-day limit**: the most check value deposited through mobile deposit in any rolling 30 calendar days, in USD.
- **New-account check hold**: for an account open fewer days than the new-account period, the business day after deposit on which a deposited check posts.
- **New-account period**: the number of calendar days after the opening date during which new-account holds apply.

## Tier table

| Tier | Mobile deposit daily limit | Mobile deposit 30-day limit | New-account check hold | New-account period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | USD 1000.00 | USD 3000.00 | 5th business day | 30 calendar days |
| Statement Savings | USD 2500.00 | USD 7500.00 | 5th business day | 30 calendar days |
| Goal Builder Savings | USD 2500.00 | USD 7500.00 | 5th business day | 30 calendar days |
| Money Market Account | USD 5000.00 | USD 15000.00 | 5th business day | 30 calendar days |
| Premier Money Market | USD 10000.00 | USD 30000.00 | 5th business day | 30 calendar days |
| Private Client Money Market | USD 25000.00 | USD 75000.00 | 5th business day | 30 calendar days |

## Reading the table

- On every tier the 30-day mobile ceiling is three times the daily ceiling; the table is the authority for each figure.
- The new-account terms are identical on all six tiers: during the first 30 calendar days after opening, a deposited check posts on the 5th business day after deposit.

## Points of judgement

**A Goal Builder Savings owner makes a mobile deposit of USD 2500.00 on a day with no earlier mobile deposits and nothing else in the rolling 30 days. Is it within both ceilings?** Yes; USD 2500.00 does not exceed the USD 2500.00 daily ceiling or the USD 7500.00 30-day ceiling.

**How long do new-account check holds last on a Private Client Money Market account?** For 30 calendar days after the opening date, the same as on every other tier.
